content.introduction: UPS announced first-quarter 2026 consolidated revenues of $21.2 billion, with a consolidated operating profit of $1.27 billion and a non-GAAP adjusted consolidated operating profit of $1.32 billion. This information was confirmed by multiple sources including Yahoo Finance and UPS's official website.
body: ATLANTA, April 28, 2026--UPS (NYSE:UPS) today announced first-quarter 2026 consolidated revenues of $21.2 billion.
